"""Measure: changed()'s `ls-files --others --exclude-standard` under git_env(tree) and git_env(tree, pinned=True).

A temporary repository; a HOME of its own whose ~/.gitconfig names an ignore file (core.excludesFile) listing
*.secret; and, separately, git's default XDG ignore file ($HOME/.config/git/ignore) listing *.xdg. Untracked:
a.secret, b.xdg, c.txt, d.repo (the last ignored by the repository's own .gitignore).
"""
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-05/src")
from gov.util.gitenv import git_binary, git_env  # noqa: E402

GIT = git_binary()
top = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="w205-measure-")
try:
    home = os.path.join(top, "home")
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(home, ".config", "git"))
    with open(os.path.join(home, "person-ignore"), "w") as f:
        f.write("*.secret\n")
    with open(os.path.join(home, ".gitconfig"), "w") as f:
        f.write(f"[core]\n\texcludesFile = {os.path.join(home, 'person-ignore')}\n")
    with open(os.path.join(home, ".config", "git", "ignore"), "w") as f:
        f.write("*.xdg\n")
    repo = os.path.join(top, "repo")
    base = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_")}
    base.update(HOME=home)
    base.pop("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", None)
    subprocess.run([GIT, "init", "-q", repo], check=True, env=git_env(None, pinned=True, base=base))
    for name in ("a.secret", "b.xdg", "c.txt", "d.repo"):
        open(os.path.join(repo, name), "w").close()
    with open(os.path.join(repo, ".gitignore"), "w") as f:
        f.write("*.repo\n")
    for pinned in (False, True):
        out = subprocess.run([GIT, "-C", repo, "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard"], capture_output=True,
                             text=True, check=True, env=git_env(repo, pinned=pinned, base=base)).stdout.split()
        print(f"pinned={pinned}: {sorted(out)}")
    # the default XDG file alone, with no core.excludesFile set anywhere
    os.remove(os.path.join(home, ".gitconfig"))
    for pinned in (False, True):
        out = subprocess.run([GIT, "-C", repo, "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard"], capture_output=True,
                             text=True, check=True, env=git_env(repo, pinned=pinned, base=base)).stdout.split()
        print(f"no ~/.gitconfig, pinned={pinned}: {sorted(out)}")
    print(subprocess.run([GIT, "--version"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip())
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(top)
